summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held September 3, 2026 (Hong Kong time). Shareholders adopted an ordinary resolution approving a 25-for-1 share consolidation of issued and unissued Class A and Class B ordinary shares, raising par value from US$0.00000005 to US$0.00000125 per share. Fractional shares will be rounded up. A special resolution approved the fourth amended and restated memorandum and articles of association to reflect the consolidation. This is a routine capital restructuring, not a special situation. What to watch: potential Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance.
